primary_goal: Independent measured prediction error under predeclared operating envelopes, not assumed simulation/physical equivalence

datasets.name: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign Propeller Database
datasets.can_validate: propulsion estimation on matching tested prop/operating envelope
datasets.cannot_validate: actual AeroForge assembled multirotor endurance, control or structural safety

datasets.name: CMU AirLab DJI Matrice 100 Package Delivery Flight Dataset
datasets.can_validate: method-level independent telemetry analytics after actual data acquisition
datasets.cannot_validate: AeroForge MN3508/P80 or generic battery pack without matching hardware and tests

datasets.name: Quadplane VTOL PX4 Flight-Test Telemetry
datasets.can_validate: existence, provenance, observed ranges, sample integrity and logger-counter consistency
datasets.cannot_validate: time-synchronised electrical integration or AeroForge-specific physical model accuracy without timestamps and hardware match

datasets.name: AMOVFLY Real-World UAV Flight Dataset
datasets.can_validate: method-level power and wind comparison following independent verification
datasets.cannot_validate: AeroForge vehicle-specific prediction accuracy on unmatched hardware

datasets.name: DroneLog PX4 Real Flight Dataset
datasets.cannot_validate: AeroForge flight model accuracy without hardware, controls and environment match

datasets.name: NASA Ames Prognostics Battery and Accelerated Life Datasets
datasets.can_validate: battery degradation method on matching Li-ion cell datasets
datasets.cannot_validate: specific 6S/12S high-C LiPo pack physical endurance without pack-specific experiments

datasets.name: IDF-DS fixed-wing UAS 240 flight telemetry benchmark
datasets.can_validate: future fixed-wing methods once that model is implemented

datasets.name: 2025 experimental ground-installation thrust of T-MOTOR G30x10.5 propeller
datasets.can_validate: physical phenomena of mounting-plate installation interference for a G30 propeller and a different MN1010 motor
datasets.cannot_validate: AeroForge P80 III motor power, installed thrust, ground effect, full-aircraft flight or hardware-safe capability
datasets.note: Nine points include Table 5 row 2 reported 3234 W inconsistent with 46.2 V times 0.7 A (32.34 W); do not correct source silently

datasets.name: Kent State Airfoil 360 Wind Tunnel Dataset (NACA 0012 & NACA 2412)
datasets.can_validate: attached-flow thin-airfoil and boundary-layer polar trends at low Reynolds numbers (DEVELOPMENT)
datasets.cannot_validate: complete 3D aircraft drag polar calibration or physical acceptance without full aircraft tests

datasets.name: NASA TM-81232 Caradonna & Tung Hovering Rotor Benchmark
datasets.can_validate: rotorcraft hover BEMT + Prandtl tip-loss thrust/power scaling trends (DEVELOPMENT)
datasets.cannot_validate: untested helicopter fuselage/tail/flight certification or transonic tip-shock acoustics

datasets.name: PX4 Flight Review Public VTOL Standard Telemetry Log (2572d282)
datasets.can_validate: VTOL hover-to-cruise speed corridor, airspeed, and 6S pack current-sag comparison (DEVELOPMENT)
datasets.cannot_validate: arbitrary VTOL frame physical certification without matching lab rig and independent review

datasets.name: NASA Glenn Common Research Model IRT Icing Wind Tunnel Database
datasets.can_validate: freezing-fraction rime vs glaze icing accretion scaling across OAT/LWC/spray time (DEVELOPMENT)
datasets.cannot_validate: rotating drone propeller icing, ice shedding loads, or wet electronics without rotor icing rigs
